# Knotwork

> Knotwork is a proof-carrying visual task factory for vision-language models. It renders seeded industrial scenes (rack patch bays, cable tangles, analog gauges, gauge panels) and releases a task only after an import-isolated kernel re-derives every answer from renderer object masks and cross-checks it against the visible image. The same certified tasks feed a diagnostic Model Arena and a post-training engine (grounded vCoT SFT, DPO, verl GRPO, a deterministic RLVR verifier). It runs fully offline with `uv`; paid model calls are opt-in.

Scope: 4 domains (rack_patch, tangle, gauge, panel), 11 question families, 19 `knot` subcommands, a 14-class fault-injection matrix (56 / 56 caught), 66 golden bundles, 560 offline tests. One Docker image runs air-gapped and unrestricted by default, or as a capped, Offline-Mock-only Cloud Run sandbox with `KNOTWORK_PUBLIC_DEMO=1`.

Live results: v1 Phase 5 audit (1,069 trials, $1.12) and the v2 four-domain audit (531 calls, k = 3, T = 0.7, $0.67; GPT-5.4 44.6 %, Gemini 2.5 Flash 28.4 %, Qwen3-VL-235B 26.6 %; post-training pack 55 SFT / 354 DPO / 59 GRPO). Evidence: docs/evidence/v2_live_audit/.

Rules for agents: the trusted kernel `src/knotwork/knotcore/` must never import plugins, network, UI or ML code; tests and gates are offline (`KNOTWORK_NETWORK=deny`); never put an API key in a file; never edit `.checkpoints/*`.

## CLI

- `uv run knot selftest --seeds-only`: determinism known-answer test (seconds, offline)
- `uv run knot selftest`: regenerate and re-verify the 66 golden bundles
- `uv run knot generate --plugin <tangle|gauge|panel> --n 20 --out data/x`: certified bundles
- `uv run knot verify data/x`: file-only re-verification; runs no plugin code
- `uv run knot mutate --fault all --n 4`: fault-injection matrix M1-M14
- `uv run knot export --data data/x --format all --out export/x`: Harbor, HF parquet, RLVR JSONL, manifest
- `uv run knot arena-run --campaign campaign.yaml --report`: run a declarative Model Arena campaign headlessly and write report.html / report.md / report_metrics.json
- `uv run knot gate --suite regression_suite.yaml --model <id> --mode mock --json-out gate.json`: CI quality gate; exit 0 pass, 1 below min_accuracy, 2 invalid suite
- `uv run knot plugins --json`: built-in and external plugins with source, version and status
- `uv run knot serve-verifier --port 8090`: stateless loopback RLVR verifier (GET /health, GET /llms.txt, POST /score, POST /score_batch)
- `uv run knot posttrain-pack --results-dir <session>/results [--approved-only]`: SFT / DPO / GRPO pack with curriculum spec, RLVR kit and provenance attestation
- `uv run knot posttrain-generate --spec curriculum_spec.json --split train --out data/train`: seed-disjoint training items
- `uv run knot bench-throughput --domain rack_patch --n 4`: gen / verify / vCoT ms per item and USD per 1M certified samples

## verl reward interface

- `knotwork.posttrain.reward.compute_score(data_source, solution_str, ground_truth, extra_info=None) -> dict`: native verl custom-reward signature; `score` = 0.60 outcome + 0.25 spatial grounding IoU + 0.15 format and abstention; `reward_hack_flag` marks a correct answer without grounding, which is gated to format credit only (score <= 0.15; raw correctness stays in `outcome_score`, `effective_outcome_score` is 0.0)
- `POST /score` body `{"data_source", "solution_str", "ground_truth", "extra_info"?}`; `POST /score_batch` body `{"items": [...]}`
- SFT target format: `<think>Step k (phase): ... <box>[x1, y1, x2, y2]</box> ...</think>` then `\boxed{answer}`, boxes on a 0-1000 grid
